Create TCPS fitting arguments

Source: R/Tcps.R
createTcpsArgs.Rd

Specifies all parameters for [fitTcps()], which fits a conditional logistic regression (CLR) stratified by exposure set.

Usage

createTcpsArgs(
  prior = NULL,
  control = NULL,
  excludedCovariateConceptIds = integer(0),
  includedCovariateConceptIds = integer(0),
  maxCohortSizeForFitting = 250000L,
  seed = 1L
)

Arguments

prior

(`cyclopsPrior`) A Cyclops prior object created with `Cyclops::createPrior()`. Defaults to a Laplace (LASSO) prior with cross-validation: `Cyclops::createPrior("laplace", variance = 0.01, useCrossValidation = TRUE)`.

control

(`cyclopsControl`) A Cyclops control object created with `Cyclops::createControl()`. Defaults to `Cyclops::createControl(noiseLevel = "silent", cvType = "auto", fold = 10, startingVariance = 0.01, seed = 1L)`.

excludedCovariateConceptIds

(`integer`) Concept IDs to exclude from the CLR (e.g. drugs on the causal pathway). Default: `integer(0)`.

includedCovariateConceptIds

(`integer`) Concept IDs to include. Empty means all. Default: `integer(0)`.

maxCohortSizeForFitting

(`integer(1)`) Maximum number of persons per treatment arm used for fitting. Persons beyond this limit are randomly sampled out. `0` means no limit. Default: `250000`.

seed

(`integer(1)`) RNG seed used when downsampling the cohort. Default: `1`.

Value

A `TcpsArgs` R6 object.

References

Suissa S, Moodie EE, Dell'Aniello S. Prevalent new-user cohort designs for comparative drug effect studies by time-conditional propensity scores. *Pharmacoepidemiol Drug Saf* 2017;26(4):459-468. doi:10.1002/pds.4117

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Default settings (Laplace prior with cross-validation)
tcpsArgs <- createTcpsArgs()

# Fast fitting for testing (fixed variance, no cross-validation)
tcpsArgs <- createTcpsArgs(
  prior   = Cyclops::createPrior("normal", variance = 0.1),
  control = Cyclops::createControl(noiseLevel = "silent")
)
} # }
